title: Cinematic trailer riser
description: "Cinematic trailer riser" (Mixkit SFX #790). Short, quiet trailer riser (2.6 s) climbing steadily to its end at ~2.5 s. Measured: 2.58 s, RMS -24.8 dBFS, -22.3 LUFS, onset 0.84 s, loudest at 2.49 s, audible to 2.57 s, brightness centroid 1550 Hz.
suggested_use: Short tension lift before a title card or the final hit; ends exactly where the next event should land.
judged_by: title/tags on the source page plus measured spectrogram and loudness envelope (not auditioned by ear)
